summary_ja: 2026年6月Green500でSiriusは37位・56.773 GFLOPS/W、Pegasusは77位・41.123 GFLOPS/Wでした。ただし公式説明の通りHPLは倍精度dense linear equationsに限定された最適化可能な指標で、実applicationや施設全体の効率を代表しません。整備計画ではjob energy、idle、network/storage、PUE、年間有効計算量で補完します。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: In the June 2026 Green500, Sirius ranked 37th at 56.773 GFLOPS/W and Pegasus ranked 77th at 41.123 GFLOPS/W. Official guidance notes that HPL is an optimizable double-precision dense linear-equation measure, not overall application or facility efficiency. Planning should complement it with job energy, idle, network/storage, PUE, and annual useful computation. Consensus is incomplete.

items.name_en: Sirius ranks 37th and Pegasus 77th in the June 2026 Green500
items.statement_ja: 公式Green500はSiriusを37位・56.773 GFLOPS/W、Pegasusを77位・41.123 GFLOPS/Wと掲載しています。一方、TOP500自身が、HPLは最適化可能な倍精度dense linear equationsの性能であり、単一の数値はsystem全体性能を表さないと説明しています。したがって順位差を一般的なapplication energy差へ直接外挿できません。
items.statement_en: The official Green500 lists Sirius at rank 37 and 56.773 GFLOPS/W and Pegasus at rank 77 and 41.123 GFLOPS/W. TOP500 itself explains that HPL measures an optimizable double-precision dense linear-equation workload and that no single number reflects overall system performance. The rank difference therefore cannot be directly extrapolated to general application energy efficiency.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 調達評価ではGreen500を初期screeningに使い、代表applicationのjob energy、idle、storage/network、冷却を含む施設電力で補完すべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Procurement may use Green500 for initial screening but should complement it with representative-application job energy, idle power, storage/network power, and facility energy.
adoption_conditions_ja: HPLと代表applicationを同じ電力境界で測る。
Rmax達成時と通常運用時のpower cap・clock・node数を記録する。
job energy、idle、PUE、年間有効計算量を別指標として併記する。
adoption_conditions_en: Measure HPL and representative applications under the same power boundary.
Record power cap, clock, and node count for both Rmax and routine operation.
Report job energy, idle power, PUE, and annual useful computation as separate metrics.
